dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: A pity that knowledge so great is constrained by matters of Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: And when there are wealthy sponsors, the wealth is not fed into valuable research but rather burned on frivolous competitions...

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: You mean the sponsor? Hm... I haven't heard much about them, but they should be a good person.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: Even merchants who think of nothing but profit should not be judged with prejudice so long as they are willing to place emphasis on the development and preservation of knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: ...Because, when it comes down to it, almost anything is better than someone who wastes money.
